title: These Robbers Didn’t See it Coming
description:
It was 1 a.m. when two robbers targeted a person exiting a railway station. Catching them completely off guard, the robbers pushed the victim hard from behind and robbed them mercilessly. In a frantic state, the victim struggled to comprehend what was happening, and the only thing that came to mind was to call 911. Fortunately, they had seen the robbers clearly, which would be a great help to the officers. Luckily, the two minions had not gone far and were lurking around in the same area. This is when the cops nabbed them. The masked mantis looked like he’d pee in his pants anytime now. Meanwhile, the other officer tried to calm the victim down as much as he could. You could see the tension on the woman’s face when the officer told her that the victim would be arriving shortly to identify them. Soon, a friend of the woman came to console her. It was going to be bad news for the robbers shortly. Police found most of the woman’s belongings. The suspects could’ve lied better. Higgins was charged with Robbery, Receiving Stolen Property, and Possession of Drug Paraphernalia while Mills was charged with Robbery, Aggravated Assault on Law Enforcement, Hindering Apprehension, Resisting Arrest, and Receiving Stolen Property.

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
